note: Rule logic lives in pbz/bpa.py (one predicate per id). Messages name objects only, never values. Ids follow microsoft/Analysis-Services BestPracticeRules/BPARules.json where one exists, so Tabular Editor ignore annotations and overlay files can use the same ids.

rules.name: Remove auto-date table
rules.message: {object} is an auto date/time table
rules.fix: turn off Auto date/time (File > Options > Data Load) and use a marked date table

rules.name: Date/calendar tables should be marked as a date table
rules.message: {object} looks like a date table but is not marked as one
rules.fix: mark it as a date table (dataCategory: Time, key date column)

rules.name: Model should have a date table
rules.message: the model has date columns but no marked date table
rules.fix: add a date table and mark it

rules.name: Do not use floating point data types
rules.message: {object} uses the floating point type double
rules.fix: use decimal (fixed decimal number) or int64

rules.name: Do not summarize numeric columns
rules.message: visible numeric column {object} summarizes by default
rules.fix: set summarizeBy: none and use explicit measures

rules.name: Hide foreign keys
rules.message: {object} is a visible many-side relationship key
rules.fix: set isHidden

rules.name: Mark primary keys
rules.message: {object} is a one-side relationship key not marked as key
rules.fix: set isKey

rules.name: Relationship columns should be of integer data type
rules.message: relationship {object} joins on a {detail} key
rules.fix: join on an integer surrogate key

rules.name: Relationship columns should be of the same data type
rules.message: relationship {object} joins columns of different data types ({detail})
rules.fix: give both key columns the same data type

rules.name: Avoid excessive bi-directional or many-to-many relationships
rules.message: {detail} relationships are bi-directional or many-to-many (limit: a {threshold} share)
rules.fix: make relationships single-direction; use CROSSFILTER in the measures that need it

rules.name: Many-to-many relationships should be single-direction
rules.message: many-to-many relationship {object} filters both directions
rules.fix: set crossFilteringBehavior to one direction

rules.name: Inactive relationships that are never activated
rules.message: inactive relationship {object} is never activated by USERELATIONSHIP or CROSSFILTER
rules.fix: delete it, or activate it in the measures that need it

rules.name: Ensure tables have relationships
rules.message: {object} has no relationships
rules.fix: relate it, or confirm it is a disconnected slicer table

rules.name: Consider a star-schema instead of a snowflake architecture
rules.message: dimension {object} is itself related to another dimension (snowflake)
rules.fix: flatten the dimensions into one table

rules.name: Remove unnecessary columns
rules.message: hidden column {object} is not used by the reports, the model or security
rules.fix: `pbz unused --remove --only column`

rules.name: Remove unnecessary measures
rules.message: hidden measure {object} is not used by the reports or the model
rules.fix: `pbz unused --remove --only measure`

rules.name: Reduce usage of calculated columns that use the RELATED function
rules.message: calculated column {object} uses RELATED
rules.fix: bring the column in with Power Query, or use a measure

rules.name: Reduce usage of calculated tables
rules.message: {object} is a calculated table
rules.fix: build it in Power Query or the source

rules.name: Use the DIVIDE function for division
rules.message: {object} divides with the / operator
rules.fix: use DIVIDE(numerator, denominator)

rules.name: Avoid using the IFERROR function
rules.message: {object} uses IFERROR
rules.fix: test the condition instead (DIVIDE, IF, ISBLANK)

rules.name: Use the TREATAS function instead of INTERSECT for virtual relationships
rules.message: {object} uses INTERSECT
rules.fix: use TREATAS

rules.name: The EVALUATEANDLOG function should not be used in production models
rules.message: {object} uses EVALUATEANDLOG
rules.fix: remove the debugging wrapper

rules.name: Column references should be fully qualified
rules.message: {object} references column(s) without a table: {detail}
rules.fix: write 'Table'[Column]

rules.name: Measure references should be unqualified
rules.message: {object} qualifies measure(s) with a table: {detail}
rules.fix: write [Measure] without the table

rules.name: No two measures should have the same definition
rules.message: {object} has the same definition as {detail}
rules.fix: keep one measure and point the others at it (or delete them)

rules.name: Measures should not be direct references of other measures
rules.message: {object} only returns {detail}
rules.fix: use the original measure, or rename it

rules.name: Filter column values with proper syntax
rules.message: {object} filters a whole table to test column values: FILTER({detail}, ...)
rules.fix: use a column predicate, e.g. KEEPFILTERS('T'[C] = ...)

rules.name: Filter measure values by columns, not tables
rules.message: {object} filters measure values over a whole table: FILTER({detail}, [Measure] ...)
rules.fix: iterate the needed columns: FILTER(VALUES('T'[C]), [Measure] ...)

rules.name: Avoid adding 0 to a measure
rules.message: {object} adds 0 (turns blanks into zeros)
rules.fix: remove + 0 unless zeros must show
rules.source: microsoft/semantic-link-labs model BPA rule 'Avoid adding 0 to a measure' (MIT)

rules.name: Avoid using '1-(x/y)' syntax
rules.message: {object} uses the 1-(x/y) pattern
rules.fix: use DIVIDE(y - x, y)

rules.name: Do not sum or average text columns
rules.message: {object} aggregates text column(s) numerically: {detail}
rules.fix: aggregate a numeric column, or use COUNTROWS / DISTINCTCOUNT

rules.name: Limit row level security (RLS) logic
rules.message: RLS filter {object} uses string functions ({detail})
rules.fix: precompute the security key in the source; keep the filter a plain comparison

rules.name: Avoid the USERELATIONSHIP function and RLS against the same table
rules.message: {object} uses USERELATIONSHIP on a table with row-level security ({detail})
rules.fix: use another relationship path or move the security filter

rules.name: Set IsAvailableInMdx to false on non-attribute columns
rules.message: hidden column {object} keeps an attribute hierarchy it does not need
rules.fix: set isAvailableInMdx: false

rules.name: Month (as a string) must be sorted
rules.message: text month column {object} has no sort-by column
rules.fix: set sortByColumn to the month number

rules.name: Provide format string for measures
rules.message: visible measure {object} has no format string
rules.fix: set formatString

rules.name: Visible objects with no description
rules.message: visible {kind} {object} has no description
rules.fix: add a /// description line

rules.name: Objects should not start or end with a space
rules.message: {kind} name {object} starts or ends with a space
rules.fix: trim the name (`pbz rename`)

rules.name: Avoid invalid characters in names
rules.message: {kind} name {object} contains control characters
rules.fix: rename it

rules.name: Expressions must only reference existing objects
rules.message: {object} references objects that do not exist: {detail}
rules.fix: fix the reference (`pbz describe`, `pbz lineage`)

rules.name: Data columns must have a source column
rules.message: data column {object} has no sourceColumn
rules.fix: set sourceColumn to the query column name

rules.name: Calculation groups with no calculation items
rules.message: calculation group {object} has no calculation items
rules.fix: add items or delete the group

rules.name: Perspectives with no objects
rules.message: perspective {object} contains no objects
rules.fix: add objects or delete it

rules.name: Add data category for columns
rules.message: geographic column {object} has no data category
rules.fix: set dataCategory (City, Country, PostalCode, ...)

rules.name: Whole numbers should be formatted with thousands separators and no decimals
rules.message: {kind} {object} uses format 0 without a thousands separator
rules.fix: use #,0

rules.name: Percentages should be formatted with thousands separators and 1 decimal
rules.message: {kind} {object} uses a percentage format without #,0.0

rules.name: Provide format string for date columns
rules.message: visible date column {object} has no explicit date format
rules.fix: set formatString (e.g. Short Date or yyyy-mm-dd)

rules.name: First letter of objects must be capitalized
rules.message: {kind} name {object} starts with a lowercase letter
rules.fix: capitalize it (`pbz rename`)

rules.name: Split date and time
rules.message: date/time column {object} holds times
rules.fix: split it into a date and a time column

rules.name: Large tables should be partitioned
rules.message: {object} is large and has one partition
rules.fix: add an incremental refresh policy

rules.name: Avoid bi-directional relationships against high-cardinality columns
rules.message: bi-directional relationship {object} uses a high-cardinality key
rules.fix: make it single-direction

rules.name: Reduce usage of long-length columns with high cardinality
rules.message: {object} is a long, high-cardinality text column
rules.fix: remove it or move it to a detail source

rules.name: Fix referential integrity violations
rules.message: relationship {object} has many-side keys missing on the one side
rules.fix: use `pbz check` no_orphans to localize, then fix the source
